note: Card heights, measured. The Design System pane sizes a card from the `viewport` in its @dsCard marker, and a card taller than its box is clipped. These were produced by the render-check loop the /design-sync skill ran; that loop is not reimplemented here, so the numbers are carried as data and a component absent from this file gets the pane's default. Re-measure a card whose stories change, and add one for a new component.
